name: erp
description: Kiyim savdosi uchun ERP: do'konlar, sklad, RFID, kassa, pul va hamkorlar hisobi

scripts.dev:server: npm run build:core && npm run dev -w server
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:agent && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @erp/core && npm run build:agent && npm run test -w @erp/agent && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run build:agent && npm run typecheck -w @erp/agent && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w web
